verdict.rationale: Stable's first-party docs say the public API supports searching for and retrieving MailItems, authenticated with self-managed API keys via the x-api-key header. Dashboard-configured webhooks notify systems of account events, so mail can be ingested programmatically like any other data source. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that scan images/PDFs can be downloaded through the API (scans are only described as a product feature), a published OpenAPI spec (the standard openapi paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MailItem endpoints.
